# Seatopia

> > Certified clean, lab-tested seafood delivered through a sustainable CSA-style model with mercury-safe standards and regenerative aquaculture practices.

Seatopia is a direct-to-consumer seafood delivery service founded by James and Daniella that emphasizes transparency, sustainability, and health through rigorous lab testing, the proprietary Seatopia Standard™, and partnerships with responsible farms. The company combines premium sushi-grade products with educational content on seafood preparation and regenerative ocean practices like kelp restoration.

## Key Topics

- Seatopia Standard™
- Lab-tested seafood
- Mercury-safe
- Microplastic-free
- Sushi-grade
- Sustainable aquaculture
- Atlantic Salmon
- Steelhead
- Scallops
- DHA & EPA
- Regenerative kelp restoration
- CSA-style delivery
- Curated boxes
- Seafood preparation
- Clean seafood

## Core Products & Shopping

- [All Seafood](https://seatopia.fish/collections/all-seafood): Complete product catalog of lab-tested, sushi-grade salmon, whitefish, and caviar.
- [Curated Boxes](https://seatopia.fish/collections/curated-boxes): Pre-selected seafood boxes featuring salmon, steelhead, and premium frozen selections.
- [Build Your Own Box](https://seatopia.fish/collections/build-your-own-box): Customizable seafood box builder featuring sushi-grade, lab-tested products like Atlantic Salmon.
- [Essentials](https://seatopia.fish/collections/essentials): Curated gourmet ingredients including sashimi kits, yuzu kosho, and specialty sauces.
- [Homepage](https://seatopia.fish): Seatopia homepage showcasing certified clean, lab-tested seafood with omega-3 and mercury-safe standards.

## How It Works & Our Story

- [How It Works](https://seatopia.fish/pages/how-it-works): Explains Seatopia's CSA-style model for sustainable, curated seafood delivery service.
- [Our Story](https://seatopia.fish/pages/our-story): Company mission and history by founders James and Daniella on regenerative aquaculture.
- [Meet Our Farms](https://seatopia.fish/pages/meet-our-farms): Profiles of partner farms including Caleta Bay, Glory Bay, and Esteros Lubimar.
- [Regenerative Kelp Restoration](https://seatopia.fish/pages/kelp-planting): Seatopia's kelp restoration and seaforestation initiative in British Columbia.

## Education & Quality Standards

- [Why Clean Seafood Matters](https://seatopia.fish/pages/why-clean-seafood-matters): Educational guide on Seatopia Standard testing, mercury safety, and microplastic detection.
- [Aquaculture 101](https://seatopia.fish/pages/aquaculture-101): Educational guide explaining sustainable aquaculture practices and Seatopia Standard.

## Cooking Classes & Recipes

- [Unleash Your Inner Chef](https://seatopia.fish/pages/unleash-your-inner-chef): Guide to free personalized cooking classes with Chef James, Miriam, Clark, and Nico.
- [Seatopia 101 - Basics](https://seatopia.fish/pages/cooking-classes-seatopia-101): Beginner virtual cooking class covering defrosting and basic sushi-grade seafood prep.
- [Seatopia 201 - Advanced](https://seatopia.fish/pages/cooking-classes-seatopia-201): Advanced interactive cooking class on poke, ceviche, and sushi hand rolls.
- [Seafood Recipes](https://seatopia.fish/blogs/seafood-recipes): Blog featuring easy seafood recipes for salmon, steelhead, scallops, and branzino.
- [Seafood 101 Recipes](https://seatopia.fish/blogs/seafood-recipes/tagged/seafood-101): Beginner-level seafood recipes and cooking techniques for shrimp, branzino, and salmon.
- [Seafood 201 Recipes](https://seatopia.fish/blogs/seafood-recipes/tagged/seafood-201): Intermediate recipes for sashimi, poke, crudo with salmon, steelhead, and scallops.
- [Seafood 301 Recipes](https://seatopia.fish/blogs/seafood-recipes/tagged/seafood-301): Advanced cooking techniques including curing and salt-baking for premium seafood.
